name: SR-17018
summary: SR-17018, also known informally as SR-17 or just SR and as 5,6-dichloro-desmethylchlorphine, is an atypical opioid receptor modulator with unusual actions and effects. It acts as a biased partial agonist of the μ-opioid receptor (MOR), showing strong selectivity for activation of G protein signaling over β-arrestin2 recruitment at this receptor.

pharmacology.text: SR-17018 acts as a biased partial agonist of the μ-opioid receptor (MOR), with strong selectivity for activation of G protein signaling over β-arrestin2 recruitment.
pharmacology.kind: μ-Opioid receptor partial agonist; μ-Opioid receptor positive allosteric modulator; Analgesic

uses.text: The drug has not been formally studied in humans. It was encountered online as a novel designer drug by 2023. Rather than being used recreationally itself, SR-17018 is typically employed by users to prevent opioid withdrawal symptoms and facilitate opioid discontinuation in the context of opioid dependence.

sideEffects.en: It has not been formally studied in people. As a mu opioid receptor agonist it can cause drowsiness and dependence, overdose may slow breathing, and stopping after regular use can bring on opioid withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 它尚未在人體進行正式研究。作為μ鴉片受體促效劑，它可能造成嗜睡與依賴，過量可能抑制呼吸，長期使用後停用也可能出現鴉片類戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它尚未在人体进行正式研究。作为μ鸦片受体促效剂，它可能造成嗜睡与依赖，过量可能抑制呼吸，长期使用后停用也可能出现鸦片类戒断症状。

fact.en: It came out of research at the Scripps Research Institute in Florida into biased opioids, drugs that favour G protein signalling over β-arrestin, in the hope of separating pain relief from side effects.
fact.zh: 它出自美國佛羅里達州斯克里普斯研究所對「偏向型」鴉片類藥物的研究，這類藥物偏好G蛋白訊號而非β-arrestin路徑，希望藉此把止痛效果與副作用分開。
fact.zhHans: 它出自美国佛罗里达州斯克里普斯研究所对「偏向型」鸦片类药物的研究，这类药物偏好G蛋白信号而非β-arrestin路径，希望借此把止痛效果与副作用分开。
